preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.
There are exactly n - 1 roads provided in the input.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct valid cities within the range [1, n].
The graph formed by the cities and roads is connected (a tree), ensuring a path exists between any pair of cities.

postconditions.description: The first line of output k equals the number of days listed in the subsequent lines.

postconditions.expression: set(range(1, n)) == set().union(*[set(day_roads) for day_roads in days])
postconditions.description: The union of all road indices across all days contains exactly the set of all road indices from 1 to n-1, ensuring every road is repaired exactly once.

postconditions.expression: all(all(not shares_vertex(edges[u-1], edges[v-1]) for u, v in combinations(day_roads, 2)) for day_roads in days)
postconditions.description: For every day, no two roads scheduled for that day share a common city (vertex), satisfying the constraint that a brigade can only work on one road per day.
The number of days k is equal to the maximum degree of any node in the tree, which is the theoretical minimum required for edge coloring a tree.
